roles.title: Quality and Process Coordinator
responsibilities: Coordinate comprehensive quality management activities and production process optimization.
Lead continuous improvement implementation on operational lines applying Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma.
Ensure compliance with ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001 quality standards and customer requirements.
Conduct internal and external audits, identifying non-conformities (NCRs) and driving 8D treatments.
achievements: Achieved 1 successful recertification of ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management System (QMS).
Passed 1 QMS maintenance audit with zero critical non-conformities.
Strengthened plant quality and operational hygiene culture aligned with customer standards.

roles.title: Quality Analyst & Manager
responsibilities: Development and implementation of quality management strategies on the production line.
Quality analysis of raw materials and inputs in close collaboration with engineering and production.
Design and supervision of quality control procedures for every production stage.
achievements: 15% reduction in production process defect rate through systematic flow control.
Design and implementation of a customer complaint tracking system yielding 30% reduction in complaints.

roles.title: Quality & Production Manager
responsibilities: Comprehensive management of production and quality leading a multidisciplinary team of engineers and supervisors.
Implementation of Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma methodologies to maximize efficiency and reduce costs.
achievements: Implementation of an automated quality control system that improved precision and speed by 30%.
Leadership in Just-in-Time system deployment, reducing inventory costs by 25%.

roles.title: Senior Purchasing Analyst & Commercial / Retail Management
responsibilities: Strategic and operational management of critical materials purchasing for automotive production.

achievements: Supply chain optimization reducing procurement costs by 15% through strategic negotiation.
Supplier development program that improved incoming quality, reducing complaints by 20%.
